name: Banaras Beads Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Banaras Beads Ltd is in the business of Manufacturing and export of Handicraft items like Glass Beads; Necklaces, Imitation Jewelry, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1][2]
Glass Beads, Fashion Jewelry & Accessories, Beads made from Clay, Brass, Aluminum, 
 Copper, Resin, Ceramics, Horn, Bone, Semiprecious stones, Agate, Lac, Hand 
 Painted Beads, Spray Painted Beads, etc. The company also trades in Leather Cords, 
Cotton Wax cords & Misc. Handicraft 
Products

pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 49.4%
Debtor days have improved from 76.4 to 59.0 days.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 4.13% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.21% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.68 Cr.
